blocks.text: Condo buildings in Eagle Ridge CQ
Eagle Ridge Court — 1170 Lansdowne Drive

The building directory records Eagle Ridge Court as built in 1981 with 36 units, and publishes its strata restrictions as "Pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed w/restrictions" — the rental line is old bylaw text: a long-term rental-restriction bylaw has been unenforceable in BC since November 24, 2022. City archives add the tenure history: a July 3, 1980 Subdivision Committee minute records a strata title conversion application for 1170 Lansdowne Street by Cressey Development Corporation, with an undertaking that existing tenants would not be ejected to ease sale of the units — the complex began as rental housing and was converted to strata. The complex's built form (low-rise apartment vs townhouse-style) is not stated in the sources checked — UNCONFIRMED; unit numbering in listings runs to at least #25. Age restrictions: none published — UNCONFIRMED beyond the pet/rental lines above.
Streets, schools and getting around Eagle Ridge CQ

items.t: Eagle Ridge is the established residential area in north-central Coquitlam along Guildford Way and Lansdowne Drive, below Westwood Plateau and beside the Port Moody border. No City neighbourhood plan boundary for Eagle Ridge is stated on a City page in the sources read — the exact boundary is UNVERIFIED; the working anchors are Guildford Way and Lansdowne Drive, with Eagle Ridge Hospital at 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody, at the area's west side.
Do not use the "Upper Eagle Ridge" rows for this area.

Where the condo stock concentrates: the Lansdowne Drive corridor at the Guildford Way end — one strata complex at 1170 Lansdowne Drive (Eagle Ridge Court) and one townhouse complex at 1135 Lansdowne Drive. The rest of the corridor is detached houses (1136, 1140, 1169 Lansdowne Drive all list as single-family in Eagle Ridge CQ) and the EagleRidge Plaza retail centre at 1192–1198 Lansdowne Drive, which is commercial, not residential strata.
Main roads: Guildford Way and Lansdowne Drive, linking west to Port Moody and east to Pinetree Way and City Centre.

blocks.text: Good to know about Eagle Ridge CQ

items.t: Eagle Ridge Court started as rentals. The City's July 3, 1980 Subdivision Committee minutes record the strata title conversion of 1170 Lansdowne Street, including a recommendation to waive the strata title conversion guideline vacancy factor of 3.5% and an undertaking protecting existing tenants — the complex's strata history begins as a conversion, which is why its documents read differently from a purpose-built strata of the same age.

One street, three sub-areas. Lansdowne Drive addresses are filed by listing sources under Eagle Ridge CQ (1135 and 1170), Upper Eagle Ridge (1215) and Westwood Plateau (Greyhawke Estates, 1495) — a "Lansdowne Drive comp set" that ignores the sub-area lines mixes three different board markets at three elevations.

Listings and sales point opposite ways here. In September 2026 strata listings outnumbered detached listings 13 to 8, yet detached sold at 25% and strata sold nothing — the sub-area's standing problem is strata liquidity, not strata supply.
The plaza at the corner is the area's commercial anchor, not housing.
The plateau amenities are not in this sub-area.

Streets, schools and getting around Eagle Ridge CQ

items.t: Keep the two Eagle Ridges separate: SnapStats carries a separate "Upper Eagle Ridge" sub-area upslope with its own rows; Westwood Plateau sits above both. Nearby areas: Westwood Plateau (north), Central Coquitlam and City Centre (south and east), Port Moody across the municipal border (west), and Hockaday (south-east toward Pinetree Way).

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: the Lansdowne Drive corridor at the Guildford Way end — the three complexes in (1135 and 1170 Lansdowne Drive, and 1141 Eagleridge Drive just off it). The rest of the corridor is detached houses.

SnapStats publishes medians at community level only: Coquitlam's combined "Condos & Townhomes" median was $625,000 in September 2026 ($687/sqft, 96% sale-to-list, 23 days on market) — combined condos-and-townhomes, never a townhome-only figure.

Transit and roads: Guildford Way and Lansdowne Drive are the main roads, linking west to Port Moody and east to Pinetree Way and City Centre; the nearest Evergreen Extension (Millennium Line) stations are Coquitlam Central and Inlet Centre, and Coquitlam Central also has West Coast Express service.

Schools: SD43 catchments are address-based. For the sample address 1195 Lansdowne Drive (Gleneagle Secondary), the SD43 School Locator result recorded in the master research (locator run 2026-10-23) is Eagle Ridge Elementary, Scott Creek Middle and Gleneagle Secondary.

Health anchor: Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody, is the Fraser Health hospital on the Port Moody / Coquitlam border at the area's west side — the facility the area shares its name with. Library: Coquitlam Public Library City Centre branch, 1169 Pinetree Way.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Eagle Ridge CQ

items.t: Form B diligence (both counted strata complexes, and Eagleridge Villas if its strata tenure is confirmed): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. Listing-level rental/pet lines in are listing data, not bylaws — the Form B and registered bylaws govern. For Eagleridge Villas the Form B is also the tenure test: if no strata exists, there is no Form B, and diligence runs on title and municipal records instead.

Watercourse check: the Watercourse Protection Development Permit Area covers all areas within 30 metres of the top of bank or top of ravine bank of any watercourse in this part of Coquitlam — a parcel-level check for slope and creek-edge lots near the complexes.

blocks.text: Good to know about Eagle Ridge CQ

items.t: One street, three sub-areas. Lansdowne Drive addresses are filed under Eagle Ridge CQ (1135 and 1170 Lansdowne, 1141 Eagleridge Drive), Upper Eagle Ridge (1215 Lansdowne) and Westwood Plateau (1495 Lansdowne, Greyhawke Estates) — a buyer searching "Lansdowne Drive townhouse" is shopping three board sub-areas on one road. (Listings cited in.)

The hospital is in the next city. Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, carries a Port Moody address — it sits on the municipal border at the area's west side, which is also why "Eagle Ridge" searches return the hospital and the mountain alongside the Coquitlam sub-area.

Strata listed 13 and sold none in September 2026. The sub-area's attached segment recorded zero sales in the month its detached segment posted a 25% sales ratio — a thin-data warning that lives in the SnapStats rows themselves, not in commentary.

The 1135 Lansdowne homes are detached-form townhouses. Listings describe completely detached townhouse units with single garages and private yards inside a 16-unit strata — house-like form with strata tenure, which is exactly why the Title to Land field, not the shape of the home, decides the diligence.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Eagle Ridge
Fee-simple lots

items.t: Established-street house lots: detached houses under the City's small-scale residential zones (R-1, R-2, R-3) on the Lansdowne / Guildford streets, with strata product in the complexes along the same corridors. Strata listings outnumbered detached listings 13 to 8 in September 2026, yet the strata segment recorded no sales that month while detached sold at a 25% ratio. A fee-simple lot carries NO strata, NO Form B and NO strata fees.

Lot character, only: subdivision minimums under Zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996 are 650 m² with 18.5 m width in R-1 and R-3, and 465 m² with 12.5 m width in R-2; SSMUH unit counts turn on the 280 m² and 4,050 m² thresholds. These are zone minimums and thresholds, not a claim about any existing lot's size — the zone and dimensions of a specific lot are confirmed parcel by parcel, UNVERIFIED for any individual lot here.
Bare-land strata: none verified
The Lansdowne pair — cross-reference only, no count taken here
Serviced position, as the City states it: Property-level septic or well status is UNVERIFIED in the research; confirm the specific lot's connections with the City before pricing any unit potential.

ALR vs non-ALR: ALR status for the sub-area is UNVERIFIED in the research; ALR status for a specific property is checked in the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder. No ALR parcel and no ALR percentage split is stated.

Hazard position: the Watercourse Protection Development Permit Area covers all areas within 30 metres of the top of bank or top of ravine bank of any watercourse in this part of Coquitlam; a Fraser River floodplain designation for Eagle Ridge's residential streets is UNVERIFIED. Lot-level watercourse / flood status is a property-specific check.
Assemblies / development sites / rezoning proposals: none documented as inventory: Nothing is presented as an assembly or a development site on this evidence.

Historic subdivisions = built lot fabric, not offerings: the Lansdowne / Guildford street fabric below Westwood Plateau is established built housing stock; nothing in it is presented as a current lot offering.

items.t: Nearby areas: Westwood Plateau above to the north, Upper Eagle Ridge as the separate board sub-area upslope, Central Coquitlam and City Centre to the south and east, Port Moody across the municipal border to the west, and Hockaday to the south-east toward Pinetree Way.

Main roads and transit: Guildford Way and Lansdowne Drive are the main roads, linking west to Port Moody and east to Pinetree Way and City Centre. The nearest Evergreen Extension (Millennium Line) stations are Coquitlam Central and Inlet Centre; Coquitlam Central also has West Coast Express service. Bus routes serving the interior streets: UNVERIFIED. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Civic anchors: Eagle Ridge Park is a City park name in City records for this part of Coquitlam (the outdoor pool / park facility address is UNVERIFIED); Coquitlam Public Library City Centre branch, 1169 Pinetree Way, is the nearest full branch (Poirier branch at 575 Poirier Street; Library Link mobile service also serves Coquitlam); City Centre Aquatic Complex and Evergreen Cultural Centre are in the City Centre area east of the sub-area (addresses UNVERIFIED in the research). Nearest hospital: Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody — the Fraser Health hospital on the Port Moody / Coquitlam border at this area's west side.

Schools: SD43 (Coquitlam) catchments are address-based. For the sample address 1195 Lansdowne Drive, Coquitlam (Gleneagle Secondary), the SD43 School Locator result recorded in the master research (locator run 2026-10-23) is Eagle Ridge Elementary, Scott Creek Middle and Gleneagle Secondary — a completed locator run for that sample address only; catchments for other addresses must be checked in the locator. School names here are Ministry-listed names, spelled exactly.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Eagle Ridge

items.t: OCP — Interim Official Community Plan, Bylaws 5511/5512, 2026: adopted April 27, 2026, superseding the Citywide OCP No. 3479, 2001 — any Eagle Ridge document still citing OCP No. 3479 as current is stale. The city-wide OCP applies; an Eagle Ridge neighbourhood plan is UNVERIFIED (none confirmed).
Subdivision + servicing requirements — VERIFIED instrument: Parcel-level servicing requirements are confirmed with the City for the specific lot.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Eagle Ridge ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

blocks.text: Good to know about Eagle Ridge

items.t: The hospital the area is named beside is in the next municipality: Eagle Ridge Hospital sits at 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody — on the Port Moody / Coquitlam border at Eagle Ridge's west side. A lot marketed as "steps to the hospital in Coquitlam" crosses a municipal line; the facility, the road and the proximity are real, the city label is not.

Coquitlam replaced its OCP in April 2026 and its servicing bylaw is a 2003 bylaw still being amended in July 2026: the Interim OCP (Bylaws 5511/5512, adopted April 27, 2026) superseded OCP No. 3479, 2001, and the Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw No. 3558, 2003 carries amendments through July 2026, including owner-paid City-installed signage and solicitor-approved statutory rights-of-way — a split priced without a Bylaw 3558 servicing estimate, or off a Bylaw 3479 plan citation, is priced on stale paper.

faq.q: What sold in Eagle Ridge in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 2 solds from 8 listings (25% sales ratio); condos & townhomes: 0 solds from 13 listings, so the sales ratio is not applicable (0 solds). At the Coquitlam community level the detached median sale price was $1,455,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $625,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Is Eagle Ridge the same as Upper Eagle Ridge or Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: No. Eagle Ridge is its own SnapStats sub-area below Westwood Plateau; Upper Eagle Ridge is a separate sub-area with separate September 2026 rows, and Westwood Plateau sits above both (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).
Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody — the Fraser Health hospital on the Port Moody / Coquitlam border at the area's west side.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 8 houses listed with 2 sold in the month and 13 condos and townhomes listed with 0 sold in the month in Eagle Ridge. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Eagle Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 25% on too few listings to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Is Eagle Ridge the same as Upper Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: Mixing their listings or solds misstates both markets.

faq.q: Eagle Ridge Court's directory says rentals are restricted — can I rent my unit out?
faq.a: A long-term rental-restriction bylaw has been unenforceable in BC since November 24, 2022, whatever the directory or old bylaw text says. A short-term rental restriction can still bind — read the registered bylaws in the Form B package.

faq.q: Are pets allowed at Eagle Ridge Court?
faq.a: The directory publishes "Pets allowed w/rest." — pets are allowed with restrictions. The specific limits (number, size, type) are in the registered bylaws; pet bylaws remain enforceable in BC.

faq.q: Why does a 1981 complex need conversion-era diligence?
faq.a: Because City archives record Eagle Ridge Court as a strata title conversion of existing rental housing (Subdivision Committee, July 3, 1980 — the developer undertook that existing tenants would not be ejected to ease unit sales). Conversion buildings carry the original rental-era systems into strata ownership; the depreciation report, CRF balance and any envelope/roof history in the Form B package are the purchase decision.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Lansdowne Drive address?
faq.a: School District 43 catchments are address-based. Run the complex's exact address — border streets toward Port Moody can differ.

faq.q: Which townhouse complexes are actually in Eagle Ridge?
faq.a: A third assigned complex, Eagleridge Villas at 1141 Eagleridge Drive, is townhouse-form-verified but its tenure is UNCONFIRMED on any citable source — diligence it first.

faq.q: Can I rent out an Eagle Ridge Court townhouse?
faq.a: Long-term, yes under provincial law: strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since Nov 24, 2022, so the directory's "rentals allowed w/restrictions" line cannot restrict a long-term rental. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw — read the registered bylaws in the Form B package.

faq.q: Is Eagle Ridge Court really townhouses, or apartments?
faq.a: What is not in doubt is the tenure history — a 1980 strata title conversion from rental housing, recorded in City archives.
